'''Red Rock''' was an area on [[M'haeli/Legends|M'haeli]] that contained a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] camp. The Rebels were forced to flee the camp after an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Battle of Red Rock|attack]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].
